instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/task-029_initial.scad in OpenSCAD and edit it. The initial side plate occupies x=[-48,48], y=[-26,26], z=[0,5] mm. Add eight equally spaced snap tabs with X centers x=-42,-30,-18,-6,6,18,30,42 mm. Every tab is an axis-aligned 8 x 6 x 3 mm solid (X x Y x Z), centered at y=23 mm and z=6.5 mm, so its bottom is on the plate top at z=5 mm and it occupies z=[5,8] mm. Directly beneath every tab, subtract one axis-aligned rectangular release slot from the plate using difference(). Each slot is 5 x 2 x 5 mm (X x Y x Z), has the same X center as its tab, is centered at y=23 mm and z=2.5 mm, and occupies x=[center_x-2.5,center_x+2.5], y=[22,24], z=[0,5] mm. The slot must be a real through-cut across the full plate thickness in the Z direction: material must be absent inside the slot, not added as a separate box. Preserve the remainder of the plate and export the final single connected solid to /home/user/Desktop/task-029_output.stl. [Software] To use OpenSCAD, run `openscad` from a terminal. Run OpenSCAD from `/usr/bin/openscad` when working on `task-029_initial.scad`.
